Michael Jordan's 1998 Finals jersey sells for $14 million

A jersey worn by Michael Jordan during the 1998 NBA Finals has been sold for $14 million. This sale makes it the second-most expensive jersey ever sold at auction, surpassed only by Babe Ruth's "called shot" jersey.
